name: corp-doctor
description: Use when a Personal Corp operating loop needs setup, repair, a new department, or task routing: HQ files and agent rules, GitHub issue workflow, corp-* owner map, department repositories, or deciding which repo an issue belongs to. Triggers: "corp doctor", "почини контур", "заведи отдел", "куда положить задачу", "настрой штаб", "проверь операционку". Replaces corp-init, corp-new and task-routing.
